reviewer: Codex war owner, actual eight images inspected

views.name: hull_rig
findings: Three masts retain square fore/main rigs and a smaller aft rig with a long triangular lateen and square topsail.
High stepped castles, a broad afterbody and two visible gun rows distinguish the Galleon silhouette; deck hatch and stair breaks remain visible between the rigs.
views.scope: Whole actual GLB with all visible hull, rig and sails.

views.name: deck_closeup
findings: A broad coaming surrounds a real opening through the separate deck planks; a stair with distinct treads, stringers and handrails descends to a lower planked level.
The wider hatch fills more of the matched 4.5 m field, with readable longitudinal grain, staggered plank joints and open spaces between the stair treads.
views.scope: Actual deck and fitting close-up at a fixed 4.5 metre physical field; rig hidden for visibility.

views.name: gun_deck_0_interior
findings: Opposing broadside gun lines sit beside actual port openings on either side of the planked working aisle, with the mast and timber step retained inside the room.
Overhead planks, transverse beams and side frames are readable nearby; the distant cannon and carriage detail fades into shadow in this intact 20 mm view.
views.label: Belowdeck battery: gun_deck_0
views.scope: Intact eye-height view along the actual belowdeck battery aisle; gun carriages, ports, hull and overhead timbers retained. Auxiliary camera fill only.

views.name: gun_deck_0_cutaway
findings: The declared cutaway exposes opposing gun stations and framed port positions within the long curved hull skeleton.
The large central hatch and descending flight remain visible among smaller framed deck apertures; hidden upper timbers and hull make this supplementary to the intact aisle view.
views.label: Belowdeck battery cutaway: gun_deck_0
views.scope: Read-only cutaway: named outer hull, upper deck timbers and bulkheads temporarily hidden; delivered GLB unchanged.

views.name: hold_interior
findings: The intact hold retains overhead beams, curved frames, longitudinal ceiling boards, a jointed planked sole and the mast seated on its timber step.
A chest and lantern sit against the side framing, leaving open foreground floor; the individual timbers, grain and plank joints read more strongly than the smooth-walled 20 mm reference hold.
views.scope: Camera inside the actual enclosed GLB room; auxiliary camera fill reveals timber and furniture.

views.name: hold_cutaway
findings: Dense curved ribs and longitudinal bilge stringers continue through the lower hull beneath the gun stations.
The separated deck heights and descending access are exposed after named covers are hidden; this skeleton view supplements the intact hold rather than claiming an open delivered hull.
views.scope: Read-only cutaway: named outer hull, upper deck timbers and bulkheads temporarily hidden; delivered GLB unchanged.

views.name: cabin_interior
findings: The intact cabin retains overhead beams, side framing and a planked sole around a full timber table with visibly supported legs.
A marked writing sheet and small brass fitting sit on the table, with a metal-framed lantern on a separate side locker; board joints and timber grain are readable at the matched 20 mm lens.
views.scope: Camera inside the actual enclosed GLB room; auxiliary camera fill reveals timber and furniture.

views.name: cabin_cutaway
findings: The declared cutaway reveals a raised timber berth with pale mattress, the table and separate side lockers on the retained aft sole.
Curved stern framing, floor edges and the rudder remain distinct after named enclosing parts are hidden; the fitted furniture remains supported by actual floor geometry.
views.scope: Read-only cutaway: named outer hull, upper deck timbers and bulkheads temporarily hidden; delivered GLB unchanged.

limitations: Static geometry and PBR inspection only; gameplay controllers and historical exactness are not certified.
The distant cannon and carriage detail is dark in the long intact battery aisle; the separate declared cutaway exposes its gun stations and port framing.
The fixed 4.5 m hatch close-up excludes guns on this broad hull; their dedicated battery and whole-ship views supply the separate layout evidence.
Cutaways hide named covers and can make retained fittings appear unsupported; intact views and the unmodified delivered GLB remain the enclosure evidence.
At 640 by 512 and twelve samples, tiny bolts, deadeye bores and rope fibres are below useful whole-ship resolution; repeating grain does not certify unique wear or exact historical timber species.
The berth is outside the intact cabin camera field and is confirmed by its separate declared cutaway.
instructions: Inspect every listed actual image and the matched old Brig reference views. Add at least two concrete observations per view. Set decision PASS only after inspection. A cutaway remains supplementary to the separate intact interior view.
reference_comparison: Deck grain and framed hatch stair compared at the reference 4.5 m orthographic field and matched area lighting.
Hold and cabin compared with the reference 20 mm lens, 1.23 m eye height and auxiliary area lighting.
Readable separate framing, ceiling, deck joints, stair joinery and furnished berth meet or exceed the reviewed reference at those disclosed scales.
